title: Zero-shot generalization of transformer neural operators to larger domains
abstract: arXiv:2606.14597v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Transformer-based neural operators have shown remarkable performance for approximating solution operators of partial differential equations on complex geometries. However, existing approaches implicitly assume a fixed domain size, which limits their ability to generalize at inference. In this work, we investigate domain extension, namely zero-shot inference on spatial domains that are significantly larger than those encountered during training. We argue that this setting fundamentally requires spatial locality and translation equivariance. We propose to implement this locality via a decomposable bias in the attention logits computation, enabling finely controllable locality while remaining fully decomposable into query-key inner products and directly compatible with optimized attention kernels. Combined with rotary positional embeddings, it enables expressive embeddings with controllable spatial support without altering the transform

translated_title: Transformer神经算子向更大域的零样本泛化
translated_abstract: 基于Transformer的神经算子在近似复杂几何上偏微分方程的解算子方面表现出色。然而，现有方法隐含地假设域大小固定，这限制了它们在推理阶段的泛化能力。在本工作中，我们研究了域扩展问题，即在比训练时所遇到的空间域大得多的域上进行零样本推理。我们认为这一设置从根本上要求空间局部性和平移等变性。我们提出通过在注意力logits计算中引入可分解的偏置来实现这种局部性，从而实现精细可控的局部性，同时保持完全可分解为查询-键内积，并直接兼容经过优化的注意力内核。结合旋转位置编码，它能够在不改变Transformer架构的情况下实现具有可控空间支撑的表达性嵌入。
tldr: 本文通过在注意力计算中引入可分解偏置并结合旋转位置编码，赋予Transformer神经算子空间局部性与平移等变性，从而实现对远大于训练域的空间域的零样本泛化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a decomposable attention bias combined with rotary positional embeddings to endow transformer neural operators with spatial locality and translation equivariance, enabling zero-shot generalization to spatial domains significantly larger than those seen during training.
